example.zh: 這個軟體要怎麼安裝？
example.en: How do I install this software?

note: Taiwan uses 體 where the mainland uses 件: 軟體, 硬體, 韌體 (firmware).

example.zh: 這裡的網路好慢喔。
example.en: The internet here is so slow.

note: Written 網路 (路, not 絡). 上網 is the same on both sides; 網路上 = online.

example.zh: 我傳一個影片給你看。
example.en: I'll send you a video to watch.

note: 視頻 is mainland usage; a YouTube video is always 影片 in Taiwan. A short clip is a 短片.

example.zh: 我剛剛收到銀行的簡訊。
example.en: I just got a text from the bank.

example.zh: 我的手機螢幕摔破了。
example.en: I cracked my phone screen.

example.zh: 這個滑鼠好像沒電了。
example.en: This mouse seems to be out of battery.

mainland: 笔记本电脑 / 笔记本

example.zh: 我都帶筆電去咖啡廳工作。
example.en: I always take my laptop to a café to work.

note: Short for 筆記型電腦. In Taiwan 筆記本 only means a paper notebook.

example.zh: 資料我等一下寄給你。
example.en: I'll send you the data in a bit.

note: Taiwan says 資料 for most of what the mainland calls 数据 (資料庫, 個人資料). 數據 is kept for statistics and figures.

example.zh: 網站上有更多活動資訊。
example.en: There's more event information on the website.

note: Mainland 信息 splits into 資訊 (information) and 訊息 (a message). IT = 資訊科技; the CS department is 資工系.

example.zh: 你有看到我傳的訊息嗎？
example.en: Did you see the message I sent?

note: 息 is read xí in Taiwan. 傳訊息 = to message someone.

example.zh: 這個檔案太大，寄不出去。
example.en: This file is too big to send.

note: 檔 is read dǎng in Taiwan. 文件 in Taiwan means a (paper or official) document, not a computer file.

example.zh: 請先登入你的帳號。
example.en: Please log in to your account first.

note: Log out = 登出 (mainland 退出登录).

example.zh: 我忘記我的帳號了。
example.en: I forgot my username.

note: Taiwan writes 帳 (not 賬) for accounts and bills: 帳號, 帳單, 結帳.

example.zh: 你去設定裡面改一下語言。
example.en: Go change the language in the settings.

example.zh: 你上網搜尋一下就有了。
example.en: Just search online and you'll find it.

note: In speech people often just say 查 or 'Google 一下'.

example.zh: 我把連結貼給你。
example.en: I'll paste you the link.

example.zh: 我要去超商列印文件。
example.en: I need to go print a document at the convenience store.

note: Colloquially just 印: 幫我印一份.

example.zh: 我每個週末都跟家人視訊。
example.en: I video-call my family every weekend.

note: 視訊 is the live call; a recorded video is 影片. 視訊會議 = video conference.

example.zh: 可以給我你的信箱嗎？
example.en: Could I have your email address?

note: Taiwan says 信箱 or just 'email'; 郵箱 sounds mainland. Also the physical letterbox.

example.zh: 我把你加進我們的群組。
example.en: I'll add you to our group chat.

note: Usually a LINE 群組 (compare mainland 微信群).

example.zh: 吃飯的時候不要一直滑手機。
example.en: Don't keep scrolling on your phone during meals.

note: 滑 = to swipe. People glued to their phones are 低頭族.

example.zh: 你有LINE嗎？我加你。
example.en: Do you have LINE? I'll add you.

note: Fills the role WeChat has on the mainland: friends, family groups, shops and even government notices.

example.zh: 我們叫計程車去車站好了。
example.en: Let's just take a taxi to the station.

note: Nicknamed 小黃 (they're all yellow). 出租車 would be taken as a rental car, and 打的 isn't used.

example.zh: 搭捷運比開車快多了。
example.en: Taking the MRT is much faster than driving.

note: Short for 大眾捷運系統. 地鐵 is understood but mostly used for subways abroad.

example.zh: 我每天搭公車上學。
example.en: I take the bus to school every day.

note: False friend: on the mainland 公车 means a government-owned official car. 公交 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 他每天騎機車上班。
example.en: He rides a scooter to work every day.

note: False friend: mainland 机车 = locomotive. Also slang for an annoying, difficult person: 他很機車.

example.zh: 我騎腳踏車去買早餐。
example.en: I ride my bike to buy breakfast.

note: Also 單車; 自行車 appears in formal and sports contexts.

example.zh: 搭高鐵到台中不用一小時。
example.en: It takes under an hour to get to Taichung by HSR.

note: Same word, but in Taiwan it means the single west-coast line from 南港 to 左營.

example.zh: 台鐵的便當很有名。
example.en: Taiwan Railways' lunch boxes are famous.

note: The regular railway, as opposed to 高鐵. Train types: 區間車 (local), 莒光號, 自強號 (express).

example.zh: 我的悠遊卡快沒錢了。
example.en: My EasyCard is almost out of credit.

note: Works on MRT, buses, trains, YouBike and in convenience stores. The southern rival is 一卡通.

example.zh: 我要去便利商店加值。
example.en: I need to go top up at the convenience store.

note: Also 儲值. 充值 is the mainland word.

example.zh: 往高雄的火車在第二月台。
example.en: The train to Kaohsiung is on platform 2.

en: traffic jam; to be stuck in traffic

example.zh: 連假高速公路一定會塞車。
example.en: The freeway is always jammed on long weekends.

note: 堵車 is understood but sounds mainland.

example.zh: 騎機車一定要戴安全帽。
example.en: You must wear a helmet when riding a scooter.

example.zh: 過了紅綠燈右轉就到了。
example.en: Turn right after the traffic light and you're there.

note: Same word. The formal term differs: 交通號誌 (mainland 交通信号灯).

example.zh: 我騎YouBike去捷運站。
example.en: I ride a YouBike to the MRT station.

note: Docked city bikes rented with an 悠遊卡; nicknamed 微笑單車 and often written Ubike.

example.zh: 咖哩裡面有很多馬鈴薯。
example.en: There's a lot of potato in the curry.

note: Don't say 土豆 for potato: in Taiwan 土豆 means peanut. Also 洋芋 in names like 洋芋片.

example.zh: 夏天的鳳梨特別甜。
example.en: Pineapples are especially sweet in summer.

note: 鳳梨酥 (pineapple cake) is the classic souvenir. 菠蘿 mostly survives in 菠蘿麵包.

example.zh: 我點了一份番茄炒蛋。
example.en: I ordered tomato scrambled eggs.

note: 西紅柿 isn't used in Taiwan. Cherry tomatoes (小番茄) are sold and eaten as fruit.

example.zh: 我早餐都吃優格配水果。
example.en: I always have yogurt with fruit for breakfast.

note: Drinkable yogurt is 優酪乳. 酸奶 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 颱風天大家都搶買泡麵。
example.en: Everyone rushes to buy instant noodles on typhoon days.

note: Formally 速食麵. 方便麵 sounds mainland.

example.zh: 中午要不要一起訂便當？
example.en: Shall we order lunch boxes together at noon?

note: From Japanese bentō. 排骨便當 and 雞腿便當 are the classics; 盒飯 isn't used.

example.zh: 今天的便當有花椰菜。
example.en: Today's lunch box has broccoli.

note: 白花椰菜 = cauliflower; 綠花椰菜 or 青花菜 = broccoli.

example.zh: 我要一個起司蛋餅。
example.en: I'd like a cheese egg crepe.

note: Also 乳酪 (rǔ luò) in names like 乳酪蛋糕. 芝士 is the Hong Kong and mainland transliteration.

example.zh: 我早餐吃吐司夾蛋。
example.en: I have an egg sandwich on toast for breakfast.

note: Means plain sliced bread too, toasted or not. Also written 土司.

mainland: 卷心菜 / 圆白菜 / 包菜

example.zh: 水餃我要高麗菜口味的。
example.en: I'll have the cabbage dumplings.

example.zh: 便利商店的烤地瓜很香。
example.en: The roasted sweet potatoes at convenience stores smell great.

note: Also 番薯. 地瓜球 (fried sweet-potato balls) are a night-market staple.

example.zh: 我從小就不敢吃紅蘿蔔。
example.en: I've hated carrots since I was a kid.

note: 胡蘿蔔 is understood. Daikon is 白蘿蔔 (or 菜頭, from Taiwanese).

example.zh: 今天晚上叫披薩來吃吧。
example.en: Let's order pizza tonight.

example.zh: 這家的義大利麵很道地。
example.en: The pasta at this place is really authentic.

note: 義, not 意: 義大利, 義式咖啡. 道地 = authentic (mainland 地道).

example.zh: 可以再給我一支湯匙嗎？
example.en: Could I have another spoon?

note: 勺子 is rarely said in Taiwan; a ladle is 湯勺. Note the classifier 支.

example.zh: 請問是內用還是外帶？
example.en: Is that for here or to go?

note: The first question at any counter. 堂食 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 我要外帶兩杯紅茶。
example.en: Two black teas to go, please.

note: 打包 in Taiwan is for boxing up leftovers after eating in.

example.zh: 下雨天叫外送最方便。
example.en: Ordering delivery is the easiest on rainy days.

note: 外賣 is the mainland and Hong Kong term. A delivery rider is an 外送員 (Uber Eats, foodpanda).

example.zh: 我請服務生幫我們加水。
example.en: I asked the waiter to refill our water.

note: Don't call out 服務員! To get the staff's attention, say 不好意思.

example.zh: 我們去吃宵夜好不好？
example.en: Shall we go get a late-night snack?

note: Reversed on the mainland (夜宵). Also written 消夜.

example.zh: 老闆，我要加一碗白飯。
example.en: Boss, one more bowl of rice, please.

note: 米飯 is rarely said in Taiwan; it's just 飯 or 白飯.

example.zh: 巷口那家早餐店很便宜。
example.en: The breakfast shop at the end of the lane is cheap.

note: A Taiwan institution serving 蛋餅, 吐司, 漢堡 and 奶茶. Chains include 美而美 and 麥味登.

example.zh: 我要一份蛋餅加起司。
example.en: One egg crepe with cheese, please.

note: The breakfast-shop staple: a thin crepe rolled around egg, sliced and eaten with soy paste.

example.zh: 我早上買了一個飯糰。
example.en: I bought a rice ball this morning.

note: Written with 糰. Either the big sticky-rice roll from breakfast stalls or the triangular 御飯糰 sold in 超商.

example.zh: 我要一碗滷肉飯加滷蛋。
example.en: A bowl of braised pork rice with a braised egg, please.

note: Often written 魯肉飯 on signs. In the south the minced version is called 肉燥飯.

example.zh: 我每天下午都要喝手搖飲。
example.en: I need a hand-shaken drink every afternoon.

note: The made-to-order tea shops on every corner (also 手搖杯). You choose sugar (甜度) and ice (冰塊).

example.zh: 我要一杯綠茶，去冰。
example.en: A green tea, no ice, please.

note: Ice levels: 正常冰, 少冰, 微冰, 去冰; some shops also offer 溫 and 熱.

example.zh: 珍珠奶茶微糖少冰。
example.en: Bubble milk tea, light sugar, less ice.

note: 微 is read wéi. Sugar levels: 全糖, 少糖, 半糖, 微糖, 無糖.

example.zh: 好熱喔，可以開冷氣嗎？
example.en: It's so hot. Can we turn on the AC?

note: 空調 is used for central systems in buildings; the unit at home is a 冷氣 (機).

example.zh: 洗髮精用完了，要再買。
example.en: We're out of shampoo; need to buy more.

note: 髮 is read fǎ in Taiwan. Conditioner = 潤髮乳 (mainland 护发素), body wash = 沐浴乳.

example.zh: 可以借我一張衛生紙嗎？
example.en: Could I borrow a tissue?

note: Covers both toilet roll and pull-out tissues; facial tissue is 面紙. 手紙 isn't used.

example.zh: 請問垃圾桶在哪裡？
example.en: Excuse me, where's the trash can?

note: Same characters, but 垃圾 is read lè sè in Taiwan. Public bins are scarce, so people carry rubbish home.

example.zh: 垃圾車來了，快去倒垃圾！
example.en: The garbage truck's here. Hurry and take out the trash!

note: There are no kerbside bins: the truck plays 〈給愛麗絲〉 and residents bring their bags out at set times.

example.zh: 洗完頭要用吹風機吹乾。
example.en: After washing your hair, dry it with a hair dryer.

example.zh: 可以借我一支原子筆嗎？
example.en: Could I borrow a ballpoint pen?

example.zh: 我有帶環保袋，不用塑膠袋。
example.en: I brought a reusable bag; I don't need a plastic one.

note: Plastic = 塑膠 in Taiwan, 塑料 on the mainland. Shops charge NT$1–2 per bag.

example.zh: 寶特瓶要拿去回收。
example.en: PET bottles need to go to recycling.

note: From 'PET'.

example.zh: 請問洗手間在哪裡？
example.en: Excuse me, where's the restroom?

note: 洗手間, 廁所 and 化妝室 are the usual words; 衛生間 sounds mainland.

example.zh: 我的皮夾忘在家裡了。
example.en: I left my wallet at home.

note: 錢包 is also used. 夾 is read jiá in Taiwan.

example.zh: 我的包包放在椅子上。
example.en: My bag is on the chair.

note: The everyday word for any handbag or backpack; a bare 包 sounds clipped in Taiwan.

example.zh: 這個橡皮擦擦不乾淨。
example.en: This eraser doesn't rub out cleanly.

note: Colloquially also 擦布 or 擦子.

example.zh: 我要去超商影印身分證。
example.en: I need to photocopy my ID at the convenience store.

note: 影印機 = photocopier; a copy is an 影本 (mainland 复印件).

example.zh: 小姐，妳的東西掉了。
example.en: Miss, you dropped something.

note: Perfectly polite in Taiwan for any woman (王小姐, 護士小姐), with none of the dubious overtones it can have on the mainland.

example.zh: 我弟弟今年要上國小。
example.en: My little brother starts elementary school this year.

note: Short for 國民小學. 小學 is also said.

example.zh: 我們是國中同學。
example.en: We were junior high classmates.

note: Short for 國民中學; grades are 國一 to 國三. 初中 is the old term.

example.zh: 我女兒在讀幼稚園。
example.en: My daughter is in kindergarten.

note: Officially renamed 幼兒園 in 2012, but most people still say 幼稚園.

example.zh: 你大學參加什麼社團？
example.en: What clubs did you join in college?

note: Student clubs like 吉他社 and 熱舞社 are central to campus life. Also a Facebook group.

example.zh: 這學期我修了六門課。
example.en: I'm taking six courses this semester.

note: Same word; 期 is read qí in Taiwan. 上學期 / 下學期.

example.zh: 寒假你有什麼計畫？
example.en: What are your plans for winter break?

note: Same word. About three weeks around Lunar New Year; the summer break is 暑假.

example.zh: 他畢業以後想考研究所。
example.en: He wants to apply to grad school after graduating.

note: 究 is read jiù. 念研究所 = do a master's or PhD (mainland 读研); on the mainland 研究所 is a research institute.

example.zh: 學長借我去年的筆記。
example.en: An older student lent me last year's notes.

note: 學姊 (f.), 學弟 and 學妹 for juniors. Also used at work and in the army for those who joined earlier.

example.zh: 下週期中考，我完蛋了。
example.en: Midterms are next week. I'm doomed.

note: 期 = qí. Finals are 期末考; Taiwan drops the 試.

example.zh: 你大學念什麼科系？
example.en: What did you major in at university?

note: 專業 isn't used for 'major' in Taiwan. Ask 你念什麼系？ or 你主修什麼？

mainland: 补习班 / 培训班 / 辅导班

example.zh: 他下課還要去補習班。
example.en: He still has cram school after class.

note: A huge part of student life. 補習 (or 補英文, 補數學) = to attend cram classes.

example.zh: 我的功課還沒寫完。
example.en: I haven't finished my homework.

note: Taiwan says 寫功課 / 寫作業 where the mainland says 做作业.

example.zh: 台灣小孩都先學注音。
example.en: Kids in Taiwan all learn Zhuyin first.

note: ㄅㄆㄇㄈ: used to teach reading and to type. Hanyu Pinyin is barely known to most Taiwanese.

example.zh: 阿嬤的國語有台語口音。
example.en: Grandma's Mandarin has a Taiwanese accent.

note: Also 中文; 普通話 is the mainland term. Mandarin taught to foreigners is 華語.

example.zh: 上班族中午都吃便當。
example.en: Office workers all have lunch boxes at noon.

note: Used on both sides now, but Taiwan rarely says 白領 in everyday speech.

example.zh: 我今天又要加班了。
example.en: I have to work overtime again today.

note: Same word. Overtime pay is 加班費; salaried jobs with no overtime pay are called 責任制.

example.zh: 這個月的薪水還沒進來。
example.en: This month's pay hasn't come in yet.

note: 工資 in Taiwan suggests hourly or manual wages (基本工資 = minimum wage).

en: to take leave; to ask for time off

example.zh: 我明天想請假去看醫生。
example.en: I'd like to take tomorrow off to see a doctor.

note: Same word. Types: 病假, 事假, 特休 (annual leave), 生理假.

example.zh: 這件事要先問過主管。
example.en: We need to check with the manager first.

note: 領導 is not used as a noun for 'boss' in Taiwan; say 主管, 老闆 or 上司.

en: to work part-time (esp. as a student)

example.zh: 我暑假在飲料店打工。
example.en: I worked part-time at a drink shop over the summer.

note: False friend: on the mainland 打工 means working any wage job. 打工度假 = working holiday.

example.zh: 我已經投了二十幾份履歷。
example.en: I've already sent out twenty-odd résumés.

note: Also 履歷表. 簡歷 is understood but uncommon.

example.zh: 他在竹科當工程師。
example.en: He works as an engineer at Hsinchu Science Park.

note: Taiwan says 軟體工程師, never 程序員. The 竹科工程師 is a stock figure: well paid and overworked.

example.zh: 我明天要跟客戶做簡報。
example.en: I'm giving a presentation to a client tomorrow.

note: 做簡報 or 報告. The slides themselves are 投影片.

example.zh: 這個專案下個月要上線。
example.en: This project goes live next month.

note: 項目 in Taiwan means an item on a list. A project manager is a 專案經理 (PM).

example.zh: 這個連假你要去哪裡玩？
example.en: Where are you going this long weekend?

note: Short for 連續假期.

example.zh: 你們公司年終發幾個月？
example.en: How many months' year-end bonus does your company pay?

note: Short for 年終獎金; quoted in months of salary and paid before Lunar New Year.

example.zh: 合約簽了就不能反悔。
example.en: Once the contract is signed, there's no going back.

note: 合同 is rarely used in Taiwan. A phone contract: 綁約兩年.

example.zh: 我想去紐西蘭打工度假。
example.en: I want to do a working holiday in New Zealand.

note: Taiwan transliterates 'New' (紐); the mainland translates it (新).

example.zh: 我們蜜月去義大利玩。
example.en: We went to Italy on our honeymoon.

note: 義, not 意: 義大利麵, 義式咖啡.

example.zh: 我表哥在澳洲念書。
example.en: My cousin is studying in Australia.

note: 澳大利亞 appears only in formal names; everyone says 澳洲.

example.zh: 北韓今天又試射飛彈了。
example.en: North Korea test-fired another missile today.

note: In Taiwan 朝鮮 refers to the historical kingdom. Note also 飛彈 = missile (mainland 导弹).

example.zh: 雪梨歌劇院真的很壯觀。
example.en: The Sydney Opera House really is spectacular.

note: Yes, the same characters as 'snow pear'. 悉尼 is unfamiliar to most Taiwanese.

example.zh: 川普又上新聞頭條了。
example.en: Trump is in the headlines again.

note: Names of foreign politicians are transliterated independently on each side.

example.zh: 歐巴馬當了八年的美國總統。
example.en: Obama was US president for eight years.

example.zh: 她明年要去法國留學。
example.en: She's going to study in France next year.

note: Same word, but the Taiwan standard reading is fà guó (法 is 4th tone only here); fǎ guó is also heard.

example.zh: 他被公司派去大陸工作。
example.en: His company sent him to work in mainland China.

note: Taiwanese say 大陸 or 中國; 內地 is not used. 陸客 = mainland tourists, 陸劇 = mainland dramas.

en: to have a cold; (fig.) to be put off by

example.zh: 我好像感冒了，喉嚨好痛。
example.en: I think I've caught a cold; my throat really hurts.

note: Same word, but note 對…很感冒 = 'can't stand' in Taiwan, whereas mainland 对…不感冒 = 'not interested in'.

en: to get or give an injection

example.zh: 小朋友都很怕打針。
example.en: Little kids are all afraid of shots.

note: Same word. An IV drip is 打點滴 (mainland 输液 / 打吊瓶).

en: to register (to see a doctor); registered (mail)

example.zh: 我已經用手機掛號了。
example.en: I've already registered on my phone.

note: Same word. You pay a 掛號費 at each visit; 掛號信 = registered mail.

example.zh: 我家樓下就有一間診所。
example.en: There's a clinic right downstairs from my place.

note: For minor illness Taiwanese go to a local 診所 (耳鼻喉科, 小兒科, 皮膚科…), not a big hospital.

example.zh: 有健保看醫生很便宜。
example.en: With NHI, seeing a doctor is cheap.

note: Short for 全民健康保險. 自費 = paid out of pocket, not covered.

example.zh: 看醫生要記得帶健保卡。
example.en: Remember your NHI card when you see a doctor.

example.zh: 我的手割到了，你有OK繃嗎？
example.en: I cut my hand. Do you have a Band-Aid?

note: From a brand name. 創可貼 is mainland usage and not widely understood.

example.zh: 我對花生跟蝦子過敏。
example.en: I'm allergic to peanuts and shrimp.

note: Same word. 鼻子過敏 (allergic rhinitis) is an extremely common complaint in humid Taiwan.

example.zh: 我去藥局買感冒藥。
example.en: I'm going to the pharmacy for cold medicine.

note: Also 藥房. 藥店 isn't used.

example.zh: 我一直流鼻水，好不舒服。
example.en: My nose keeps running; I feel awful.

note: 鼻涕 exists too, but the symptom is always 流鼻水.

example.zh: 我頭痛，想早點回家休息。
example.en: I have a headache and want to go home early to rest.

note: Taiwan says 痛 nearly everywhere northern China says 疼: 頭痛, 肚子痛, 牙痛.

example.zh: 這個節目每週六晚上播。
example.en: This show airs every Saturday night.

note: Same word. Note that 播 is read bò in Taiwan: 播出, 轉播, 直播.

example.zh: 他是有百萬粉絲的網紅。
example.en: He's an influencer with a million followers.

note: Same word. Video creators are simply called YouTuber.

example.zh: 她每天晚上開直播賣衣服。
example.en: She goes live every night selling clothes.

note: Same word, but 播 is read bò. A streamer is a 直播主 (mainland 主播).

example.zh: 沒有字幕我聽不太懂。
example.en: Without subtitles I can't really follow.

note: Same word. Taiwanese TV subtitles almost everything, Mandarin shows included.

example.zh: 阿嬤每天晚上都看連續劇。
example.en: Grandma watches her drama serial every night.

note: 八點檔 = the 8 p.m. prime-time soap. Korean and Japanese dramas are 韓劇 and 日劇.

mainland: 剧 / 美剧 / 电视剧

example.zh: 最近有什麼好看的影集？
example.en: Are there any good series lately?

note: False friend: mainland 影集 = photo album (Taiwan 相簿).

example.zh: 小時候放學都在看卡通。
example.en: As a kid I watched cartoons after school.

note: 動畫 is used for animation or anime as a medium; 動畫片 isn't said.

example.zh: 五月天是我最愛的樂團。
example.en: Mayday is my favourite band.

note: 樂隊 in Taiwan suggests a marching band.

example.zh: 我阿姨每天都在臉書發文。
example.en: My aunt posts on Facebook every day.

note: Usually just 'FB'. Still big in Taiwan for groups (社團) and business pages (粉專).

example.zh: 她的貼文有一萬個讚。
example.en: Her post has ten thousand likes.

note: To post = 發文 or 'po文'. 帖子 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 記得幫我的影片按讚。
example.en: Remember to like my video.

note: The YouTuber sign-off: 按讚、訂閱、開啟小鈴鐺.

example.zh: 我有追蹤她的IG。
example.en: I follow her on Instagram.

note: 關注 in Taiwan just means 'to pay attention to'. Followers = 追蹤者 or 粉絲.

example.zh: 氣象預報說明天會下雨。
example.en: The forecast says it'll rain tomorrow.

note: Also 氣象報告. The weather agency is the 中央氣象署.

example.zh: 發票要留著，可以對獎喔。
example.en: Keep the receipt. You can check it for prizes.

note: Every purchase gets a numbered 統一發票 that doubles as a lottery ticket. Mainland 发票 is a tax invoice you have to ask for.

example.zh: 牛奶今天特價，買一送一。
example.en: Milk is on sale today, buy one get one free.

note: Same word. Typical deals: 買一送一, 第二件六折. Remember 八折 = 20% off.

example.zh: 請問這裡可以刷卡嗎？
example.en: Excuse me, can I pay by card here?

note: Same word. Many small eateries and market stalls are cash only (只收現金).

example.zh: 百貨公司週年慶人超多。
example.en: Department stores are packed during the anniversary sale.

note: E.g. 新光三越, SOGO. 商場 is used for malls.

example.zh: 便利商店可以繳水電費。
example.en: You can pay utility bills at convenience stores.

note: 7-ELEVEN (小七), 全家, 萊爾富, OK. You can also ship parcels, print, and buy train tickets there.

example.zh: 我去超商領個包裹。
example.en: I'm going to the convenience store to pick up a parcel.

note: Not a supermarket (超市): 超商 always means a convenience store.

en: to pay the bill; to check out

example.zh: 不好意思，我要結帳。
example.en: Excuse me, I'd like to pay.

note: 買單 is also used in restaurants. Written with 帳.

example.zh: 請到櫃檯結帳，謝謝。
example.en: Please pay at the counter, thank you.

note: Also written 櫃台. 前台 isn't used; a hotel front desk is also 櫃檯.

mainland: 店员 / 营业员 / 售货员

example.zh: 我問店員有沒有別的顏色。
example.en: I asked the clerk if they had other colours.

example.zh: 這個可以宅配到家嗎？
example.en: Can this be delivered to my home?

note: From Japanese 宅配便. 黑貓宅急便 is the best-known courier.

example.zh: 滿五百元就免運費。
example.en: Free shipping on orders over NT$500.

note: Short for 免運費. 包郵 is mainland usage.

example.zh: 這個牌子的品質很好。
example.en: This brand's quality is very good.

note: 質 is read zhí. In Taiwan 質量 means 'mass' (physics), never 'quality'.

example.zh: 這家餐廳的CP值很高。
example.en: This restaurant is great value for money.

note: From 'cost–performance ratio'. 性價比 is mainland usage.

example.zh: 我住在沒有電梯的老公寓。
example.en: I live in an old walk-up apartment with no elevator.

note: In Taiwan 公寓 usually means an older 4–5-storey walk-up; buildings with elevators are 電梯大樓 or 華廈.

example.zh: 他住在捷運站旁邊的大樓。
example.en: He lives in the high-rise next to the MRT station.

note: 電梯大樓 = residential tower with elevator, guard desk and monthly 管理費.

example.zh: 我在公司附近租了一間套房。
example.en: I rented a studio near the office.

note: False friend: mainland 套房 = a multi-room suite or flat. In Taiwan it's one room with its own bathroom.

example.zh: 房東說下個月要漲房租。
example.en: The landlord says the rent goes up next month.

note: Same word. The tenant is the 房客 (mainland 租客).

mainland: 门卫 / 保安 / 物业

example.zh: 包裹請管理員幫我代收。
example.en: I asked the doorman to accept the parcel for me.

note: Staffs the lobby desk of a 大樓 and takes in parcels and registered mail. Also 警衛.

example.zh: 衣服曬在陽台就好。
example.en: Just hang the clothes on the balcony.

note: Same word. The washing machine usually lives on the back balcony (後陽台).

en: to rent a home; rental housing

example.zh: 在台北租屋真的很貴。
example.en: Renting in Taipei is really expensive.

note: Also 租房子. The go-to listings site is 591租屋網.

mainland: 煤气 / 燃气 / 天然气

example.zh: 出門前記得關瓦斯。
example.en: Remember to turn off the gas before going out.

note: Via Japanese ガス. 天然氣 is piped gas; a 瓦斯桶 is a delivered cylinder.

example.zh: 我們社區有游泳池。
example.en: Our complex has a swimming pool.

note: 小區 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 我們訂了車站附近的飯店。
example.en: We booked a hotel near the station.

note: In Taiwan a 飯店 is a hotel, not a restaurant. Careful with 酒店: outside hotel brand names it suggests a hostess club.

example.zh: 我們在花蓮住民宿。
example.en: We stayed at a B&B in Hualien.

note: Same word, originally from Japanese minshuku; the default for domestic trips.

example.zh: 辦手機門號要帶身分證。
example.en: You need your ID card to get a phone line.

note: Taiwan writes 身分 (分, not 份). The ID number (身分證字號) is one letter plus nine digits.

en: Republic (ROC) era, Taiwan's official year count

example.zh: 我是民國八十五年生的。
example.en: I was born in ROC year 85 (1996).

note: ROC year = Western year − 1911, so 2026 is 民國115年. Used on IDs, receipts, forms and expiry dates.

example.zh: 便利商店裡面都有提款機。
example.en: Convenience stores all have ATMs inside.

note: Also just ATM. 提款 = to withdraw; 取款 isn't used.

example.zh: 我先去領錢，等我一下。
example.en: I'm going to get some cash first; wait for me.

note: 取錢 isn't said in Taiwan.

example.zh: 一美金大概換三十塊台幣。
example.en: One US dollar is about thirty NT dollars.

note: Formally 新台幣 (TWD). The spoken unit is 塊; written 元.

example.zh: 外國人要先辦居留證。
example.en: Foreigners need to get a resident certificate first.

note: Needed to open a bank account, get a phone contract and join 健保.

example.zh: 請附上身分證影本。
example.en: Please attach a photocopy of your ID.

note: The original is the 正本 (mainland 原件).

example.zh: 下課後我們去打籃球。
example.en: We're going to play basketball after class.

note: Same word, but the jargon differs: 灌籃 (扣篮), 阻攻 (盖帽), 抄截 (抢断), 延長賽 (加时赛).

example.zh: 棒球是台灣的國球。
example.en: Baseball is Taiwan's national sport.

note: Same word. Baseball terms differ: 全壘打 (本垒打), 捕手 (接手), 打者 (击球员).

example.zh: 我爸每個週末都去打桌球。
example.en: My dad plays table tennis every weekend.

note: False friend: mainland 桌球 usually means billiards. 乒乓球 is understood; billiards in Taiwan is 撞球.

example.zh: 我們晚上要去打羽球。
example.en: We're going to play badminton tonight.

note: 羽毛球 is the full form; everyday speech says 羽球.

example.zh: 她是台灣最有名的羽球選手。
example.en: She's Taiwan's most famous badminton player.

note: 運動員 is rarely used; 選手 covers athletes, e-sports players and contestants. National-team members are 國手.

example.zh: 台灣在奧運拿過羽球金牌。
example.en: Taiwan has won Olympic gold in badminton.

note: Taiwan drops the 會: 奧運, 亞運. It competes under the name 中華台北 (Chinese Taipei).

example.zh: 我身高一百七十公分。
example.en: I'm 170 centimetres tall.

note: 厘米 isn't used. Metric units take 公 in Taiwan: 公分, 公尺, 公里, 公克, 公斤, 公升.

example.zh: 我最近胖了三公斤。
example.en: I've put on three kilos lately.

note: Careful with bare 斤: in Taiwan it's the 台斤 (600 g), not the mainland 市斤 (500 g).

example.zh: 往前走一百公尺就到了。
example.en: Walk a hundred metres ahead and you're there.

note: 米 for metres is understood but sounds mainland.

en: ping (unit of floor area, about 3.3 m²)

example.zh: 這間套房大概八坪。
example.en: This studio is about eight ping.

note: 1 坪 ≈ 3.3 m² (two tatami mats). All housing sizes and prices are quoted per 坪.

example.zh: 我想買一台新的機車。
example.en: I want to buy a new scooter.

note: Taiwan uses 台 for cars, scooters, bikes, computers, TVs and so on; 輛 sounds formal.

en: classifier for shops, companies, schools, rooms

example.zh: 這間餐廳的牛肉麵很好吃。
example.en: This restaurant's beef noodles are delicious.

note: Taiwan says 一間店, 一間公司, 一間學校 where the mainland prefers 家 or 所.

en: classifier for phones, pens, videos, bottles

example.zh: 我想換一支新的手機。
example.en: I want to get a new phone.

note: 一支手機, 一支筆, 一支影片, 一支湯匙. The mainland says 一部手机.

example.zh: 這台電腦的硬體太舊了。
example.en: This computer's hardware is too old.

example.zh: 辦公室的印表機又卡紙了。
example.en: The office printer is jammed again.

example.zh: 我的硬碟快要滿了。
example.en: My hard drive is almost full.

note: Disk = 碟 in Taiwan (硬碟, 光碟, 隨身碟), 盘 on the mainland.

example.zh: 檔案我存在隨身碟裡。
example.en: I saved the file on the flash drive.

example.zh: 你有帶行動電源嗎？
example.en: Did you bring a power bank?

note: 行動 = 'mobile' in Taiwan (行動電話, 行動支付, 行動網路); the mainland uses 移动.

example.zh: 他從國中就開始寫程式。
example.en: He's been coding since junior high.

note: 寫程式 = to code. 程序 in Taiwan only means 'procedure'.

example.zh: 政府正在推動數位轉型。
example.en: The government is pushing digital transformation.

note: 數位相機, 數位學習. In Taiwan 數字 only means 'number, figure'.

example.zh: 照片都放在這個資料夾。
example.en: The photos are all in this folder.

note: 夾 is read jiá in Taiwan. Also a physical document folder.

example.zh: 預設的密碼是四個零。
example.en: The default password is four zeros.

example.zh: 阿嬤也開始用智慧型手機了。
example.en: Grandma has started using a smartphone too.

note: 'Smart' is 智慧 in Taiwan (智慧手錶, 智慧家電), 智能 on the mainland.

example.zh: 人工智慧發展得很快。
example.en: AI is developing very fast.

note: In conversation most people just say AI.

example.zh: 記憶體不夠，電腦跑很慢。
example.en: There's not enough RAM, so the computer runs slowly.

example.zh: 伺服器好像又掛了。
example.en: The server seems to be down again.

example.zh: 她在部落格分享旅遊心得。
example.en: She shares her travel experiences on her blog.

note: A blogger is a 部落客.

example.zh: 客戶名單都存在資料庫裡。
example.en: The customer list is all stored in the database.

example.zh: 地下室的訊號很差。
example.en: The signal in the basement is terrible.

note: Phone reception is also called 收訊: 這裡收訊不好.

en: (of a device) to crash; to freeze

example.zh: 我的電腦又當機了。
example.en: My computer froze again.

note: 當 is read dàng here. Also said jokingly of people: 我腦袋當機了.

example.zh: 你重開機試試看。
example.en: Try restarting it.

example.zh: 記得先儲存再關掉。
example.en: Remember to save before you close it.

note: 儲 is read chú in Taiwan (mainland chǔ). 儲值 = to top up credit.

example.zh: 我忘記存檔就關掉了。
example.en: I closed it without saving.

example.zh: 複製以後貼上就好了。
example.en: Just copy it and then paste.

note: Copy-paste = 複製貼上; cut = 剪下 (mainland 剪切).

example.zh: 照片我都備份在雲端。
example.en: I back up all my photos to the cloud.

note: 雲端硬碟 = cloud drive (mainland 云盘 / 网盘).

example.zh: 你有多的傳輸線可以借我嗎？
example.en: Do you have a spare cable I could borrow?

note: For charging, people also say 充電線.

example.zh: 新手機要先貼保護貼。
example.en: A new phone needs a screen protector first.

example.zh: 公司的網站被駭客入侵了。
example.en: The company's website was broken into by hackers.

note: 被駭 = to get hacked.

example.zh: 新版的介面比較好用。
example.en: The new version's interface is easier to use.

example.zh: 請先下載這個應用程式。
example.en: Please download this application first.

note: In speech everyone says 'APP', spelled out letter by letter: A-P-P.

example.zh: 台灣的晶片產業很有名。
example.en: Taiwan's chip industry is famous.

note: 晶圓 = wafer. 台積電 (TSMC) is the giant of 晶圓代工 (foundry work).

example.zh: 這門課可以線上報名。
example.en: You can sign up for this course online.

note: 線上課程, 線上購物. Taiwan rarely says 在線.

example.zh: 我弟弟很愛打電玩。
example.en: My little brother loves playing video games.

note: Colloquially 打電動.

example.zh: 我把他的帳號封鎖了。
example.en: I blocked his account.

example.zh: 她很愛傳可愛的貼圖。
example.en: She loves sending cute stickers.

note: LINE 貼圖 are a big part of how Taiwanese people chat.

en: to support (a format or feature); to back up

example.zh: 這支手機不支援無線充電。
example.en: This phone doesn't support wireless charging.

note: Technical 'support' is 支援; 支持 is for backing a person or an idea.

example.zh: 程式執行到一半就停了。
example.en: The program stopped halfway through running.

note: Colloquially 跑: 這個程式跑不動.

example.zh: 上飛機前記得開飛航模式。
example.en: Remember to turn on airplane mode before boarding.

example.zh: 網頁重新整理一下就好了。
example.en: Just refresh the page and it'll be fine.

example.zh: 不要隨便把個資給別人。
example.en: Don't give out your personal data carelessly.

note: Short for 個人資料. The privacy law is the 個資法; a data leak is 個資外洩.

example.zh: 搭客運去台中比較便宜。
example.en: Taking a coach to Taichung is cheaper.

note: Operators include 國光客運 and 統聯客運.

example.zh: 我們在台北轉運站搭客運。
example.en: We catch the coach at Taipei Bus Station.

example.zh: 區間車每一站都會停。
example.en: The local train stops at every station.

note: You can ride with an 悠遊卡; there are no seat reservations.

example.zh: 到台北車站再轉乘板南線。
example.en: Transfer to the Bannan line at Taipei Main Station.

note: Colloquially 轉車 or 換車.

example.zh: 這附近很難找到停車格。
example.en: It's hard to find a parking space around here.

note: Also 停車位 / 車位. Scooter bays are 機車格.

example.zh: 我下個月要去考機車駕照。
example.en: I'm taking my scooter license test next month.

note: Formal: 駕駛執照 (mainland 驾驶证). Tests are taken at the 監理站.

example.zh: 前面的路口可以迴轉。
example.en: You can make a U-turn at the next intersection.

note: Also written 回轉. 掉頭 is understood.

example.zh: 行李放後車廂就好。
example.en: Just put the luggage in the trunk.

note: The storage space under a scooter seat is the 車廂 or 置物箱.

example.zh: 下雨天要提早煞車。
example.en: Brake early on rainy days.

note: Taiwan writes 煞車; the mainland writes 刹车.

example.zh: 請出示護照和登機證。
example.en: Please show your passport and boarding pass.

example.zh: 長榮航空在第二航廈。
example.en: EVA Air is in Terminal 2.

note: Everyone says háng xià, though dictionaries give 廈 as shà in building names (大廈).

example.zh: 我的班機延誤了兩個小時。
example.en: My flight was delayed by two hours.

note: 航班 is also used, but 班機 is more common in everyday speech.

example.zh: 空服員開始發餐了。
example.en: The flight attendants have started serving meals.

note: 空姐 is also used colloquially, as on the mainland.

example.zh: 畢業旅行我們坐遊覽車。
example.en: We went by tour bus on our graduation trip.

example.zh: 高鐵站有免費的接駁車。
example.en: There's a free shuttle bus at the HSR station.

example.zh: 我在公車站牌等你。
example.en: I'll wait for you at the bus stop.

note: Buses only stop if you wave them down (招手); press the bell (下車鈴) to get off.

mainland: 爱心专座 / 老弱病残孕专座

example.zh: 博愛座要讓給需要的人。
example.en: Priority seats should be given to those who need them.

note: Officially renamed 優先席 in 2025, but 博愛座 is still what most people say.

example.zh: 買來回票有比較便宜嗎？
example.en: Is it cheaper to buy a round-trip ticket?

note: One-way = 單程票.

example.zh: 自由座在十到十二車。
example.en: Non-reserved seats are in cars 10 to 12.

note: On the 高鐵; from Japanese 自由席. Reserved seats are 對號座.

example.zh: 手扶梯在出口的左邊。
example.en: The escalator is to the left of the exit.

note: Also 電扶梯.

example.zh: 阿公喜歡吃土豆配啤酒。
example.en: Grandpa likes peanuts with his beer.

note: False friend: mainland 土豆 = potato. From Taiwanese thôo-tāu; the standard word 花生 is just as common.

example.zh: 便利商店有賣優酪乳。
example.en: Convenience stores sell drinking yogurt.

note: 酪 is read luò in Taiwan.

example.zh: 紐西蘭的奇異果很甜。
example.en: New Zealand kiwis are very sweet.

example.zh: 芭樂沾梅子粉很好吃。
example.en: Guava dipped in plum powder is delicious.

note: From Taiwanese. Also figurative: 芭樂歌 = cheesy pop ballad, 芭樂票 = bad cheque.

example.zh: 我早餐吃鮪魚三明治。
example.en: I had a tuna sandwich for breakfast.

note: Hong Kong says 吞拿魚.

example.zh: 我最愛吃鮭魚生魚片。
example.en: Salmon sashimi is my favourite.

note: 三文魚 is the Cantonese-derived name used on the mainland. 生魚片 = sashimi (mainland 刺身).

example.zh: 我用果汁機打木瓜牛奶。
example.en: I make papaya milk in the blender.

note: 打 is the verb for blending: 打果汁.

example.zh: 三杯雞一定要加九層塔。
example.en: Three-cup chicken has to have basil.

note: Also essential on 鹹酥雞 (fried chicken bites).

example.zh: 我要一杯現榨柳丁汁。
example.en: A freshly squeezed orange juice, please.

note: Written 柳橙 on packaging (柳橙汁). 橙子 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 我想喝酪梨牛奶。
example.en: I feel like an avocado milkshake.

note: 酪 is read luò. 牛油果 is the Hong Kong and mainland name.

example.zh: 看電影配洋芋片最棒了。
example.en: Chips with a movie are the best.

note: French fries are 薯條 on both sides.

example.zh: 這家店的可頌很酥。
example.en: This shop's croissants are really flaky.

note: A transliteration of the French; also 牛角麵包.

example.zh: 我的三明治不要加美乃滋。
example.en: No mayonnaise in my sandwich, please.

note: Via Japanese マヨネーズ. Taiwan's version is noticeably sweet.

example.zh: 我要一杯鮮奶茶，微糖。
example.en: A fresh-milk tea, light sugar, please.

note: On drink menus 奶茶 is made with creamer (奶精) and 鮮奶茶 with real milk. UHT milk is 保久乳.

example.zh: 我有帶筷子，不用免洗筷。
example.en: I brought my own chopsticks; no disposable ones needed.

note: 免洗 = disposable: 免洗杯, 免洗餐具. 一次性 is mainland usage.

example.zh: 公司附近有一家自助餐。
example.en: There's a cafeteria near the office.

note: In Taiwan usually a cheap pick-your-own-dishes canteen priced by item or weight. All-you-can-eat is 吃到飽.

example.zh: 火鍋裡我最愛加冬粉。
example.en: Glass noodles are my favourite thing to add to hot pot.

note: False friend: 粉絲 in Taiwan only means fans (of a star).

example.zh: 夜市的花枝丸很好吃。
example.en: The cuttlefish balls at the night market are delicious.

note: Squid proper is 魷魚 (large) or 透抽 / 小卷.

example.zh: 吐司塗奶油再烤很香。
example.en: Toast spread with butter and grilled smells great.

note: In Taiwan 奶油 covers butter (mainland 黄油); whipping cream is 鮮奶油.

example.zh: 小孩子都愛吃速食。
example.en: Kids all love fast food.

note: 速食店 = fast-food restaurant. 快餐 in Taiwan suggests a quick set meal.

example.zh: 下班後我們去吃熱炒吧。
example.en: Let's go for stir-fry and beers after work.

note: Also 快炒. Noisy places with NT$100 dishes and Taiwan Beer: the classic after-work gathering.

example.zh: 我買了一塊雞排當晚餐。
example.en: I bought a chicken cutlet for dinner.

note: The face-sized night-market cutlet. Stock questions: 要切嗎？要辣嗎？

example.zh: 飯店有提供沐浴乳。
example.en: The hotel provides body wash.

note: Taiwan favours 乳 / 精 where the mainland uses 露 / 液 / 奶: 洗面乳, 洗衣精, 洗碗精.

example.zh: 包包裡要放一包面紙。
example.en: Keep a pack of tissues in your bag.

example.zh: 寫錯了，你有立可白嗎？
example.en: I made a mistake. Do you have correction fluid?

note: From the brand Liquid Paper. Correction tape is 立可帶.

example.zh: 我用釘書機把它釘起來。
example.en: I'll staple it together.

note: Also written 訂書機. Staples are 釘書針.

example.zh: 今天晚上有收資源回收。
example.en: They're collecting recycling tonight.

note: Often just 回收. Rubbish is split into 一般垃圾, 資源回收 and 廚餘.

example.zh: 廚餘要另外倒，不能丟垃圾桶。
example.en: Food waste goes separately; it can't go in the trash can.

example.zh: 化妝室在二樓電梯旁邊。
example.en: The restroom is next to the elevator on the second floor.

note: Polite signage in department stores and restaurants: it's the toilet, not a dressing room.

example.zh: 浴室的蓮蓬頭在漏水。
example.en: The shower head in the bathroom is leaking.

example.zh: 我忘記帶刮鬍刀了。
example.en: I forgot to bring my razor.

example.zh: 洗衣精倒一蓋就夠了。
example.en: One capful of detergent is enough.

note: Powder is 洗衣粉 on both sides.

example.zh: 洗碗精沒了，幫我買一瓶。
example.en: We're out of dish soap. Buy me a bottle.

example.zh: 梅雨季沒有烘衣機很麻煩。
example.en: Not having a dryer in the plum-rain season is a pain.

example.zh: 台北很潮濕，一定要買除濕機。
example.en: Taipei is very humid; you really need a dehumidifier.

note: A household essential in Taiwan's climate.

mainland: 插线板 / 接线板 / 插排

example.zh: 插座不夠，要買一條延長線。
example.en: There aren't enough sockets; we need a power strip.

example.zh: 我背後背包去爬山。
example.en: I take a backpack when I go hiking.

example.zh: 我每天帶保溫瓶裝熱水。
example.en: I carry hot water in a thermos every day.

note: 保溫杯 is also used.

example.zh: 考試可以帶計算機嗎？
example.en: Can we bring a calculator to the exam?

note: False friend: mainland 计算机 = computer. In Taiwan a computer is 電腦; 計算機 as 'computer' survives only in course names like 計算機概論.

example.zh: 天氣變冷了，要蓋厚棉被。
example.en: It's getting cold; time for a thick quilt.

note: 被子 is also understood; 棉被 is the default word whatever the filling.

example.zh: 去北海道要帶羽絨衣。
example.en: You'll need a down jacket for Hokkaido.

note: Also 羽絨外套.

example.zh: 夏天出門要戴太陽眼鏡。
example.en: Wear sunglasses when you go out in summer.

note: 墨鏡 is also common.

example.zh: 去海邊記得擦防曬乳。
example.en: Remember to put on sunscreen at the beach.

note: 擦 is the verb for applying creams: 擦防曬, 擦乳液, 擦藥.

example.zh: 她花很多錢買保養品。
example.en: She spends a lot on skincare products.

note: 保養 = to look after one's skin; also to service a car.

example.zh: 用電鍋蒸一下就可以吃了。
example.en: Just steam it in the rice cooker and it's ready.

note: Usually the Tatung outer-pot steamer (大同電鍋) found in every home; a regular rice cooker is a 電子鍋.

example.zh: 我買了一個藍牙喇叭。
example.en: I bought a Bluetooth speaker.

note: Also a car horn (按喇叭), as on the mainland.

example.zh: 寒流來了，記得帶暖暖包。
example.en: A cold front is coming; remember your hand warmers.

example.zh: 我每天自己帶便當盒。
example.en: I bring my own lunch box every day.

note: Offices and schools have a 蒸飯箱 for steaming them hot.

example.zh: 吃完雞排用濕紙巾擦手。
example.en: Wipe your hands with a wet wipe after the chicken cutlet.

example.zh: 我習慣用洗面乳洗臉。
example.en: I'm used to washing my face with cleanser.

example.zh: 收到你的卡片覺得好窩心。
example.en: Getting your card felt so heart-warming.

note: False friend: on the mainland 窝心 means feeling aggrieved and bottling it up.

example.zh: 這家餐廳的水準很高。
example.en: This restaurant is of a very high standard.

note: 水平 in Taiwan mostly means 'horizontal'. For skill level, 程度 is even more common: 英文程度.

en: GSAT (university entrance exam held in January)

example.zh: 高三生一月要考學測。
example.en: High-school seniors take the GSAT in January.

note: Short for 學科能力測驗. The closest thing to the mainland 高考, though it's one of several admission routes.

example.zh: 我們班導超級嚴格。
example.en: Our homeroom teacher is super strict.

note: Short for 班級導師; also simply 導師.

example.zh: 我在讀資工所碩士班。
example.en: I'm in the CS master's program.

note: 博士班 = PhD program. Colloquially 碩一, 碩二 for first and second year.

example.zh: 這門課是開給大學部的。
example.en: This course is offered for undergraduates.

note: 本科 isn't used in Taiwan: an undergraduate is a 大學生 and the degree is 學士.

example.zh: 學姊帶我們參觀校園。
example.en: An older student showed us around campus.

note: Also written 學姐.

example.zh: 考試前一定要寫考古題。
example.en: You have to do past papers before the exam.

note: Literally 'archaeology questions'.

example.zh: 下禮拜就要段考了。
example.en: Term exams are next week already.

note: The two or three big exams per semester in junior and senior high.

example.zh: 老師今天要發考卷。
example.en: The teacher is handing back the exam papers today.

example.zh: 成績單會寄到家裡。
example.en: The report card will be mailed home.

note: Same word, but 績 is read jī in Taiwan (mainland jì).

example.zh: 我的指導教授人很好。
example.en: My advisor is really nice.

note: False friend: 導師 in Taiwan is a homeroom teacher. Grad students jokingly call their advisor 老闆.

example.zh: 今天的營養午餐有雞腿。
example.en: Today's school lunch has a chicken drumstick.

example.zh: 下課去福利社買飲料。
example.en: Go to the school shop for a drink at break.

note: Also 合作社.

example.zh: 小孩放學後先去安親班。
example.en: The kids go to after-school care when school lets out.

example.zh: 媽媽每天都要簽聯絡簿。
example.en: Mom has to sign the communication book every day.

note: Elementary pupils copy the day's homework into it for a parent to sign.

example.zh: 這個國字我不會寫。
example.en: I can't write this character.

note: In Taiwan 漢字 is used mostly for Japanese kanji or in academic contexts.

example.zh: 我高中國文老師很有趣。
example.en: My high-school Chinese teacher was really fun.

note: 國語 in elementary school, 國文 from junior high on; heavy on classical Chinese (文言文).

example.zh: 很多外國人來台灣學華語。
example.en: Lots of foreigners come to Taiwan to study Mandarin.

note: 華語中心 = university Mandarin centre; the proficiency test is TOCFL (華語文能力測驗).

example.zh: 我正在練習寫繁體字。
example.en: I'm practising writing traditional characters.

note: The government's term is 正體字 ('standard characters'). Simplified = 簡體字; 簡體 / 繁體 for short.

example.zh: 老師會把投影片放上網。
example.en: The teacher will put the slides online.

note: Often just 'PPT'. The presentation as a whole is a 簡報.

example.zh: 國立大學的學費比較便宜。
example.en: Tuition at national universities is cheaper.

note: E.g. 國立台灣大學. National universities are the most prestigious and cheaper than 私立 ones.

example.zh: 我大三去日本當交換學生。
example.en: I went to Japan as an exchange student in my junior year.

note: Also shortened to 交換生; 去交換 = go on exchange.

example.zh: 很多公司要求多益成績。
example.en: Many companies ask for a TOEIC score.

note: The English test Taiwanese employers care about most. TOEFL is 托福 on both sides.

example.zh: 今年尾牙我抽到一台電視！
example.en: I won a TV at this year's year-end party!

note: Held before Lunar New Year with a lucky draw (抽獎). The spring equivalent is 春酒.

example.zh: 我還有五天特休沒用完。
example.en: I still have five days of annual leave left.

note: Short for 特別休假.

en: to clock in or out; to check in (on social media)

example.zh: 我們公司上下班都要打卡。
example.en: At our company we have to clock in and out.

note: Same word. 打卡景點 = an Instagram-worthy spot.

example.zh: 他在保險公司當業務。
example.en: He works in sales at an insurance company.

note: 跑業務 = do field sales. 銷售 is used for sales as an activity or figure.

mainland: 兼职学生 / 勤工俭学生

example.zh: 超商在徵晚班工讀生。
example.en: The convenience store is hiring part-timers for the evening shift.

note: Hourly staff in general are 計時人員 or PT.

example.zh: 她在廣告公司做企劃。
example.en: She works as a planner at an ad agency.

note: 企 is read qì in Taiwan. A proposal is a 企劃案 or 企劃書.

example.zh: 他們的行銷做得很成功。
example.en: Their marketing has been very successful.

example.zh: 我畢業後想找一份正職。
example.en: I want to find a full-time job after graduation.

note: Opposites: 兼職, 打工, 約聘 (fixed-term contract).

example.zh: 計程車費可以報帳嗎？
example.en: Can I claim the taxi fare?

note: Keep the 發票 with the company's 統編 printed on it.

example.zh: 我下午要跟廠商開會。
example.en: I have a meeting with a vendor this afternoon.

example.zh: 正職員工都有勞健保。
example.en: Full-time employees all get labour and health insurance.

note: 勞保 + 健保, which employers must provide. 勞退 = the labour pension fund.

example.zh: 明天放颱風假，不用上班！
example.en: Tomorrow's a typhoon day. No work!

note: Each city or county government announces 停班停課 the night before.

example.zh: 這個禮拜六要補班。
example.en: We have a make-up workday this Saturday.

note: A Saturday worked in exchange for a bridge holiday; schools have 補課.

example.zh: 我們公司週休二日。
example.en: Our company has two-day weekends.

note: 雙休 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 我們公司可以遠距上班。
example.en: Our company lets us work remotely.

note: 遠距工作, 遠距教學; also 居家辦公 or WFH.

example.zh: 她想進外商公司工作。
example.en: She wants to work for a foreign company.

note: Mainland-funded firms are 陸資; Taiwanese businesspeople in China are 台商.

example.zh: 活動結束後我們來檢討一下。
example.en: Let's do a review after the event.

note: False friend: neutral in Taiwan (檢討會, 檢討考卷 = go over the exam); on the mainland 检讨 is a self-criticism.

example.zh: 我把會議加到行事曆了。
example.en: I've added the meeting to the calendar.

note: Google Calendar is 'Google 行事曆' in Taiwan.

example.zh: 今年員工旅遊要去沖繩。
example.en: This year's company trip is to Okinawa.

note: Shortened to 員旅.

example.zh: 寮國是東南亞的內陸國家。
example.en: Laos is a landlocked country in Southeast Asia.

pinyin: shā wū dì ā lā bó

example.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯是產油大國。
example.en: Saudi Arabia is a major oil producer.

note: Short forms: 沙國 or 沙烏地 (mainland 沙特).

example.zh: 新聞說南韓下週要大選。
example.en: The news says South Korea has an election next week.

note: Everyday speech says 韓國; 南韓 is common in the news, paired with 北韓.

example.zh: 卡達航空的服務很好。
example.en: Qatar Airways has great service.

example.zh: 我們在杜拜轉機去歐洲。
example.en: We transferred in Dubai on the way to Europe.

example.zh: 他們去馬爾地夫度蜜月。
example.en: They went to the Maldives on their honeymoon.

example.zh: 峇里島是熱門的度假勝地。
example.en: Bali is a popular holiday destination.

note: 峇 (bā) is a character you'll rarely see anywhere else.

example.zh: 普丁是俄羅斯總統。
example.en: Putin is the president of Russia.

example.zh: 賈伯斯是蘋果的創辦人。
example.en: Steve Jobs was the founder of Apple.

note: Bill Gates is 比爾蓋茲 (mainland 比尔·盖茨); 馬斯克 (Musk) is the same on both sides.

example.zh: 《蒙娜麗莎》是達文西畫的。
example.en: The Mona Lisa was painted by da Vinci.

note: The Da Vinci Code is 《達文西密碼》.

example.zh: 我很喜歡梵谷的《星夜》。
example.en: I really like van Gogh's Starry Night.

note: Likewise 莫內 (Monet, mainland 莫奈).

mainland: 泰勒·斯威夫特 / 霉霉

example.zh: 泰勒絲的演唱會一票難求。
example.en: Taylor Swift concert tickets are nearly impossible to get.

note: Taiwan media give stars short Chinese-style names: 小賈斯汀, 女神卡卡, 紅髮艾德.

mainland: 输液 / 吊瓶 / 点滴

example.zh: 醫生說我要打點滴。
example.en: The doctor says I need an IV drip.

example.zh: 我喉嚨發炎，吞口水都痛。
example.en: My throat is inflamed; it hurts even to swallow.

note: Same word. 消炎藥 = anti-inflammatory.

en: (of a doctor) to see patients; consultation

example.zh: 王醫師今天下午沒有看診。
example.en: Dr. Wang isn't seeing patients this afternoon.

note: Patients say 看醫生 (rather than 看病); clinic hours are 看診時間 or 門診時間.

example.zh: 拿處方箋去藥局領藥。
example.en: Take the prescription to a pharmacy to collect your medicine.

note: A 慢性病連續處方箋 can be refilled at any 健保藥局.

example.zh: 請到二號櫃檯領藥。
example.en: Please collect your medicine at counter 2.

note: 領 is Taiwan's verb for picking things up: 領錢, 領包裹, 領藥.

example.zh: 產檢要照超音波。
example.en: You get an ultrasound at prenatal check-ups.

note: The verb is 照: 照超音波, 照X光. B超 isn't used.

example.zh: 公司每年都有員工健檢。
example.en: The company gives staff a health check every year.

note: Short for 健康檢查. 體檢 is used for military or school physicals.

example.zh: 護理師來幫我量血壓。
example.en: The nurse came to take my blood pressure.

note: The official title; 護士 (護士小姐) is still common in speech.

example.zh: 陳醫師的門診都很多人。
example.en: Dr. Chen's clinic is always packed.

note: Used as a title after the surname. 大夫 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 小孩發燒要看小兒科。
example.en: A child with a fever should see a paediatrician.

note: Also 兒科.

example.zh: 我每週去做兩次復健。
example.en: I go to physio twice a week.

note: 復健科 = rehab department.

example.zh: 便利商店有賣衛生棉。
example.en: Convenience stores sell sanitary pads.

note: A tampon is a 衛生棉條.

example.zh: 便利商店也有賣保險套。
example.en: Convenience stores sell condoms too.

example.zh: 進門前先用乾洗手消毒。
example.en: Sanitise your hands before coming in.

mainland: 抗原检测 / 快速检测

example.zh: 我快篩兩條線，確診了。
example.en: My rapid test showed two lines. I'm positive.

note: From the COVID years: 確診 = confirmed case, 隔離 = quarantine.

example.zh: 我腰很痠，貼了一塊貼布。
example.en: My lower back is sore, so I put on a patch.

note: 痠 (suān) is the Taiwan character for muscle soreness: 痠痛.

example.zh: 頭痛的話吃一顆普拿疼。
example.en: If you have a headache, take a Panadol.

note: The household name for paracetamol in Taiwan.

example.zh: 我每天早上吃一顆維他命。
example.en: I take a vitamin every morning.

note: 維生素 is the formal, scientific term. 維他命C is the everyday name for vitamin C.

example.zh: 我每半年去捐血一次。
example.en: I donate blood every six months.

note: 捐血車 (bloodmobiles) park outside stations. 血 is usually read xiě in speech.

example.zh: 憂鬱症需要專業的治療。
example.en: Depression needs professional treatment.

example.zh: 她生理期來，肚子很痛。
example.en: Her period came and her stomach really hurts.

note: The polite everyday term; 例假 isn't used. Menstrual leave is 生理假.

example.zh: 我室友晚上打呼很大聲。
example.en: My roommate snores really loudly at night.

example.zh: 我喜歡看日本的綜藝節目。
example.en: I like watching Japanese variety shows.

note: 綜 is read zòng in Taiwan. Often shortened to 綜藝.

example.zh: 她從小看台灣偶像劇長大。
example.en: She grew up watching Taiwanese idol dramas.

note: A genre Taiwan made famous in the 2000s with 《流星花園》.

example.zh: 那個主播的聲音很好聽。
example.en: That anchor has a lovely voice.

note: In Taiwan 主播 means a news anchor or sportscaster; a live-streamer is a 直播主 or 實況主.

example.zh: 她是很紅的遊戲直播主。
example.en: She's a really popular game streamer.

note: Game streamers are also called 實況主.

example.zh: 我家沒有裝第四台。
example.en: We don't have cable at home.

note: Literally 'the fourth channel', after the three original terrestrial stations. Formal: 有線電視.

example.zh: 他很喜歡聽饒舌歌。
example.en: He really likes listening to rap.

note: A rapper is a 饒舌歌手. 嘻哈 (hip-hop) is the same on both sides.

example.zh: 影片下面有很多人留言。
example.en: Lots of people commented under the video.

note: 評論 in Taiwan is a review or critique, not a social-media comment.

example.zh: 大家都用串流平台看劇。
example.en: Everyone watches shows on streaming platforms.

note: 串流平台 = Netflix, Disney+ and the like.

example.zh: 這個頻道有高畫質直播。
example.en: This channel has an HD live stream.

note: 質 is read zhí. 畫質 = picture quality.

en: to record video; to tape (a show)

example.zh: 演唱會裡面不能錄影。
example.en: No video recording inside the concert.

note: Audio recording is 錄音 on both sides.

example.zh: 昨天的完結篇你看了嗎？
example.en: Did you watch yesterday's finale?

note: 大結局 is also heard.

example.zh: 這個實境秀最近很紅。
example.en: This reality show is really popular lately.

note: VR is 虛擬實境 (mainland 虚拟现实).

example.zh: 現在大家都愛看短影音。
example.en: Everyone loves watching short videos these days.

note: Reels, Shorts, TikTok (抖音).

mainland: 新闻发布会 / 记者会

example.zh: 市長下午要開記者會。
example.en: The mayor is holding a press conference this afternoon.

example.zh: 手機可以看即時新聞。
example.en: You can read breaking news on your phone.

note: 即時新聞, 即時通訊, 即時翻譯. 實時 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 《鐵達尼號》我看了三次。
example.en: I've seen Titanic three times.

note: Film titles are translated separately in Taiwan and often differ completely.

example.zh: 《魔戒》三部曲是經典。
example.en: The Lord of the Rings trilogy is a classic.

note: The Hobbit is 《哈比人》 (mainland 《霍比特人》).

example.zh: 我爸是《星際大戰》的鐵粉。
example.en: My dad is a die-hard Star Wars fan.

example.zh: 他最喜歡的英雄是鋼鐵人。
example.en: His favourite hero is Iron Man.

note: Taiwan uses 人 where the mainland uses 侠: also 蜘蛛人 (Spider-Man). 蝙蝠俠 (Batman) is the same on both sides.

example.zh: 這期統一發票我中了兩百塊！
example.en: I won NT$200 in this round of the receipt lottery!

note: Winning numbers are drawn every two months; 對獎 or 對發票 = check your receipts.

example.zh: 發票幫我存載具，謝謝。
example.en: Please save the receipt to my carrier, thanks.

note: A 手機條碼 that stores e-receipts in the cloud, so no paper. Cashiers ask 有載具嗎？

example.zh: 超商集點可以換玩偶。
example.en: You can redeem convenience-store stickers for plush toys.

note: Sticker-collecting promotions (集點活動) are a 超商 tradition.

example.zh: 這張卡的點數可以折抵現金。
example.en: The points on this card can be used as cash.

note: 積分 in Taiwan is for sports standings.

example.zh: 我有一張五十元的折價券。
example.en: I have a NT$50 coupon.

note: 優惠券 is also used.

mainland: 移动支付 / 手机支付

example.zh: 這裡可以用行動支付嗎？
example.en: Can I use mobile payment here?

note: LINE Pay, 街口支付, Apple Pay. Cash is still far more common than on the mainland.

example.zh: 我想等週年慶再買。
example.en: I want to wait for the anniversary sale to buy it.

note: The big autumn sale season, roughly October to December.

example.zh: 週末我們去量販店買東西。
example.en: We go shopping at the hypermarket on weekends.

note: From Japanese. E.g. 家樂福, 大潤發; also called 大賣場.

example.zh: 好市多的烤雞很划算。
example.en: Costco's roast chicken is a great deal.

note: Brand names often differ: 愛迪達 (Adidas, mainland 阿迪达斯), 海尼根 (Heineken, mainland 喜力).

example.zh: 媽媽習慣去傳統市場買菜。
example.en: Mom is used to buying groceries at the traditional market.

note: Also 菜市場.

example.zh: 夜市裡有很多攤販。
example.en: There are lots of vendors in the night market.

note: A stall is a 攤子 or 攤位; a roadside food stand is a 路邊攤.

example.zh: 我身上都沒有銅板。
example.en: I don't have any coins on me.

note: 硬幣 is the formal word. 銅板價 = dirt cheap; 銅板美食 = snacks that cost only coins.

example.zh: 夜市買衣服可以殺價。
example.en: You can haggle when buying clothes at the night market.

example.zh: 這台電腦有兩年保固。
example.en: This computer has a two-year warranty.

note: 保固期 = warranty period; 過保 = out of warranty.

example.zh: 網購我都選超商取貨。
example.en: I always choose store pickup when I shop online.

note: Ship orders to a nearby 7-ELEVEN or 全家 and pay on pickup (取貨付款). Shortened to 超取.

example.zh: 我在蝦皮買了一個手機殼。
example.en: I bought a phone case on Shopee.

note: Taiwan's most-used marketplace app, roughly what 淘宝 is on the mainland. Others: momo, PChome.

example.zh: 新手機明天開放預購。
example.en: Pre-orders for the new phone open tomorrow.

example.zh: 中午去地下的美食街吃吧。
example.en: Let's eat at the basement food court at noon.

note: Usually in the basement of department stores and malls.

example.zh: 請先抽號碼牌再等叫號。
example.en: Please take a number first and wait to be called.

note: You 抽號碼牌 at banks, post offices and clinics; busy restaurants hand them out too.

example.zh: 結帳的時候出示條碼就好。
example.en: Just show the barcode when you pay.

note: 二維碼 isn't used: Taiwanese say 'QR Code' (formally 行動條碼).

example.zh: 買牛奶要看保存期限。
example.en: Check the expiry date when buying milk.

note: Also 有效期限 or 賞味期限. Dates are often printed in ROC years. 保質期 isn't used.

example.zh: 這家咖啡廳低消一杯飲料。
example.en: This café has a one-drink minimum.

note: Short for 最低消費.

example.zh: 雅房比較便宜，但要共用浴室。
example.en: A room with shared bath is cheaper, but you share the bathroom.

note: The counterpart of 套房 in rental listings.

example.zh: 上一個房客留下很多垃圾。
example.en: The previous tenant left a lot of rubbish behind.

example.zh: 這棟大樓的管理費很貴。
example.en: This building's management fee is expensive.

note: 物業 isn't an everyday word in Taiwan.

example.zh: 頂樓加蓋的房間夏天很熱。
example.en: Rooftop add-on rooms get very hot in summer.

note: Cheap rentals built on top of old 公寓, usually illegal structures (違建). Shortened to 頂加.

example.zh: 南部很多人住透天厝。
example.en: In the south many people live in townhouses.

note: From Taiwanese: a multi-storey house owned from ground to roof, often with a shop or garage downstairs.

en: two bedrooms and a living room

example.zh: 我們想找兩房一廳的房子。
example.en: We're looking for a two-bedroom place.

note: Rooms are counted in 房, not 室: 三房兩廳兩衛.

example.zh: 這間套房不能用瓦斯爐。
example.en: You can't use a gas stove in this studio.

note: An induction hob is a 電磁爐 or IH爐.

example.zh: 下雨天走騎樓就不會淋濕。
example.en: On rainy days, walk under the arcades and you won't get wet.

note: The covered sidewalk under shophouses; often cluttered with parked scooters.

example.zh: 他們的新家還在裝潢。
example.en: Their new home is still being fitted out.

note: 裝修 is understood; 裝潢 is the everyday word.

example.zh: 我們請房仲帶我們看房子。
example.en: We asked an agent to show us places.

note: Short for 房屋仲介. 'Agent, broker' in general is 仲介 (mainland 中介).

example.zh: 我們還在存買房的頭期款。
example.en: We're still saving for the down payment on a home.

note: 期 = qí. The mortgage is 房貸 on both sides.

example.zh: 電梯裡面有監視器。
example.en: There's a security camera in the elevator.

note: 調監視器 = pull the CCTV footage.

example.zh: 大樓晚上有保全巡邏。
example.en: Security guards patrol the building at night.

note: 保安 isn't used for guards in Taiwan. A guard at a gate is also a 警衛.

mainland: 户籍科 / 派出所户籍窗口

example.zh: 結婚登記要去戶政事務所。
example.en: You register a marriage at the household registration office.

note: Handles IDs, births, marriages and address changes. Shortened to 戶政.

example.zh: 我的戶籍還在台南。
example.en: My registered address is still in Tainan.

note: The booklet is the 戶口名簿 (mainland 户口本). It decides where you vote, not where you may live.

example.zh: 有問題可以去找里長幫忙。
example.en: If there's a problem you can ask the neighbourhood chief for help.

note: Elected head of a 里, the smallest urban administrative unit; the rural equivalent is a 村長.

example.zh: 這個補助要去區公所申請。
example.en: You apply for this subsidy at the district office.

example.zh: 請問這裡的郵遞區號是多少？
example.en: What's the postal code here?

note: Three digits identify the district (e.g. 106 = 大安區), with three more for full precision.

example.zh: 西元二〇二六年是民國一一五年。
example.en: 2026 CE is ROC year 115.

note: 公元 isn't used in Taiwan.

mainland: 税号 / 统一社会信用代码

example.zh: 請問發票要打統編嗎？
example.en: Would you like a company tax ID on the receipt?

note: Short for 統一編號, the 8-digit business number printed on receipts for expense claims.

example.zh: 我要去銀行補登存摺。
example.en: I need to go to the bank to update my passbook.

note: Paper passbooks are still standard; 補登 = print new transactions at a machine.

example.zh: 房租我都用轉帳的。
example.en: I always pay the rent by bank transfer.

note: Same word, written with 帳. ATM 轉帳 is a very common way to pay; a remittance is 匯款.

example.zh: 薪水會直接匯到戶頭。
example.en: Your salary goes straight into your account.

note: Also 帳戶. 開戶 = open an account.

example.zh: 我的金融卡被提款機吃掉了。
example.en: The ATM swallowed my bank card.

note: Also 提款卡. 銀行卡 isn't an everyday term in Taiwan.

example.zh: 去銀行開戶要帶印章。
example.en: Bring your seal when opening a bank account.

note: Same word, but name chops are still required for banking, contracts and registered mail (蓋章).

example.zh: 我想換五百塊美金。
example.en: I'd like to change 500 US dollars.

note: 美元 is used in writing and the news; 美金 in speech.

example.zh: 最近日幣很便宜。
example.en: The yen has been cheap lately.

note: Also 日圓 in writing. Likewise 韓幣, 泰銖, 人民幣.

example.zh: 他明年想出來選立委。
example.en: He wants to run for legislator next year.

note: Short for 立法委員, a member of the 立法院 (parliament).

example.zh: 颱風假由各縣市自己決定。
example.en: Typhoon days are decided by each county and city.

note: Taiwan's local governments: six 直轄市 plus the 縣 and 市.

en: section (of a long road, in addresses)

example.zh: 我們約在忠孝東路四段。
example.en: Let's meet on Zhongxiao East Road, Section 4.

note: Addresses nest 路 › 段 › 巷 › 弄 › 號 › 樓, e.g. 和平東路二段50巷3弄8號5樓.

example.zh: 他家在五十巷三弄八號。
example.en: His place is at No. 8, Alley 3, Lane 50.

note: Read lòng as an address unit (nòng as a verb). A 巷 is a lane; a 弄 branches off a lane.

example.zh: 辦護照要帶身分證正本。
example.en: Bring your original ID card when applying for a passport.

note: A copy is an 影本.

example.zh: 辦護照要兩張大頭照。
example.en: You need two ID photos for a passport.

note: Sized as 一吋 or 二吋; 證件照 is also used.

example.zh: 我的生日是國曆五月三號。
example.en: My birthday is May 3rd on the solar calendar.

note: Opposed to 農曆 (lunar). Also 陽曆.

example.zh: 國定假日銀行沒有開。
example.en: Banks are closed on public holidays.

note: E.g. 二二八, 清明, 端午, 中秋, 雙十 (國慶日).

example.zh: 政府有提供租屋補助。
example.en: The government offers a rent subsidy.

note: 補貼 is also used, but 補助 is the everyday word.

example.zh: 延長居留要去移民署辦。
example.en: You extend your residency at the immigration agency.

note: Where foreigners apply for and renew the 居留證.

example.zh: 台灣有十六個原住民族。
example.en: Taiwan has sixteen recognised indigenous peoples.

note: The official, respectful term. The PRC label 高山族 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 我們去撞球場打撞球吧。
example.en: Let's go shoot some pool at the pool hall.

note: 台球 isn't used in Taiwan.

example.zh: 我們公司聚會去打保齡球。
example.en: Our company outing was bowling.

note: Same word.

example.zh: 他身高夠高，可以灌籃。
example.en: He's tall enough to dunk.

note: Hence 《灌籃高手》 (Slam Dunk).

example.zh: 九局下他打出再見全壘打！
example.en: He hit a walk-off home run in the bottom of the ninth!

note: 再見全壘打 = walk-off homer. Base = 壘 on both sides, and home plate is 本壘.

example.zh: 兩隊打到延長賽才分出勝負。
example.en: The two teams needed overtime to settle it.

example.zh: 世界盃足球賽四年一次。
example.en: The football World Cup is held every four years.

note: Taiwan writes 盃 for trophies and tournaments: 世界盃, 獎盃.

example.zh: 游泳我只會自由式。
example.en: I can only swim freestyle.

note: Strokes end in 式: 蛙式 (蛙泳), 仰式 (仰泳), 蝶式 (蝶泳).

example.zh: 我一週去健身房重訓三次。
example.en: I do weight training at the gym three times a week.

note: Short for 重量訓練.

example.zh: 我每天做五十下伏地挺身。
example.en: I do fifty push-ups every day.

note: Counted with 下.

example.zh: 週末我們去陽明山健行。
example.en: We're going hiking on Yangmingshan this weekend.

note: 登山 or 爬山 for proper mountains; 健行 for trail walks.

mainland: 中华台北队 / 中国台北队

example.zh: 我們一起幫中華隊加油！
example.en: Let's all cheer for Team Taiwan!

note: What Taiwanese call their national team in any sport; fans also say 台灣隊.

example.zh: 現在的比數是三比二。
example.en: The score is now three to two.

example.zh: 兩隊最後打成平手。
example.en: The two teams ended in a draw.

example.zh: 週末要不要去看職棒？
example.en: Want to go watch pro baseball this weekend?

note: 中華職棒 (CPBL) is famous for its noisy cheer squads. 職籃 = pro basketball.

example.zh: 運動前要先拉筋。
example.en: Stretch before you exercise.

note: A warm-up is 暖身 or 熱身.

example.zh: 演唱會在台北小巨蛋舉行。
example.en: The concert is at Taipei Arena.

note: Via Japanese ('Big Egg' = Tokyo Dome). 小巨蛋 = Taipei Arena, 大巨蛋 = Taipei Dome.

example.zh: 我家附近的運動中心有游泳池。
example.en: The sports centre near my place has a pool.

note: Each Taipei district has a cheap city-run 運動中心 with gym, pool and courts.

example.zh: 一台斤等於六百公克。
example.en: One Taiwanese catty equals 600 grams.

note: At markets just 斤. 1 台斤 = 16 兩; the mainland 市斤 is 500 g.

example.zh: 這包餅乾只有五十公克。
example.en: This pack of biscuits is only fifty grams.

example.zh: 汽油一公升大概三十塊。
example.en: Petrol is about NT$30 a litre.

example.zh: 這瓶水是六百CC。
example.en: This bottle of water is 600 ml.

note: Written c.c. on menus and bottles and said 'CC'; also for engine size (一二五CC的機車). 毫升 is the formal word.

example.zh: 一坪大約是三點三平方公尺。
example.en: One ping is roughly 3.3 square metres.

example.zh: 我買了一台五十五吋的電視。
example.en: I bought a 55-inch TV.

note: 吋 (also 英吋) for screens, pizzas and cakes; 寸 is the traditional Chinese unit.

example.zh: 手機電量只剩十趴。
example.en: My phone's only got ten percent battery left.

note: From 'percent' (via Japanese パーセント): 二十趴 = 20%. Informal speech only.

example.zh: 這個便當有八百大卡。
example.en: This lunch box is 800 kilocalories.

note: Food labels use 大卡; calories in general are 熱量 or 卡路里.

example.zh: 你的作業系統該更新了。
example.en: Your operating system needs updating.

example.zh: 把這個視窗關掉就好了。
example.en: Just close this window.

note: In Taiwan 窗口 is a service counter or a contact person, not a UI window.

example.zh: 這段程式碼是誰寫的？
example.en: Who wrote this piece of code?

note: Source code = 原始碼 (mainland 源代码).

example.zh: 這個物件有三個屬性。
example.en: This object has three properties.

note: False friend: 對象 in Taiwan mostly means a romantic partner or a target. Realtors also call a listing a 物件.

example.zh: 演算法一直推薦我貓的影片。
example.en: The algorithm keeps recommending me cat videos.

example.zh: 變數的名字要取清楚。
example.en: Variable names should be clear.

note: Also figurative: 還有很多變數 = still many uncertainties. Function = 函式, array = 陣列, string = 字串.

example.zh: 價格寫在第三欄。
example.en: The price is in the third column.

note: Watch out: Taiwan 列 = row and 欄 = column; mainland 行 = row and 列 = column.

example.zh: 請把第一列的標題改掉。
example.en: Please change the header in the first row.

note: False friend: on the mainland 列 is a column. Taiwan mnemonic: 直行橫列 (行 vertical, 列 horizontal).

example.zh: 她去做了近視雷射手術。
example.en: She had laser surgery for her nearsightedness.

note: A transliteration of 'laser': 雷射印表機, 雷射筆.

example.zh: 我訂了早上八點的自強號。
example.en: I booked the 8 a.m. Tze-Chiang express.

note: 台鐵's fastest class, with reserved seats. Newer trainsets include 普悠瑪 and 太魯閣號.

mainland: 高速出入口 / 互通立交

example.zh: 下一個交流道下去就到了。
example.en: Get off at the next interchange and we're there.

example.zh: 國道一號又大塞車了。
example.en: Freeway No. 1 is badly jammed again.

note: In Taiwan 國道 are the (tolled) freeways; mainland 国道 are ordinary national trunk roads.

example.zh: 還好我有裝行車紀錄器。
example.en: Luckily I have a dashcam installed.

example.zh: 車子停紅線被拖吊了。
example.en: The car was towed for parking on a red line.

note: 紅線 = no stopping or parking at all; 黃線 = no parking, but brief stops are allowed.

example.zh: 機車左轉要先到待轉區。
example.en: Scooters turning left must first go to the waiting box.

note: At big junctions scooters do a 兩段式左轉: ride across, wait in the box, then go with the cross traffic.

example.zh: 他開一台黑色的賓士。
example.en: He drives a black Mercedes.

note: Car brand names often differ: 福斯 (VW, mainland 大众), 速霸陸 (Subaru, mainland 斯巴鲁).

example.zh: 台東的釋迦又大又甜。
example.en: Taitung's sugar apples are big and sweet.

note: Named for looking like the Buddha's head (釋迦牟尼).

example.zh: 辦公室只有即溶咖啡。
example.en: The office only has instant coffee.

note: 即溶 = instant (of powders); the mainland says 速溶.

example.zh: 寒流來的時候要開電暖器。
example.en: Turn on the heater when a cold front hits.

note: Homes in Taiwan have no central heating (暖氣).

example.zh: 用奇異筆在箱子上寫名字。
example.en: Write your name on the box with a marker.

note: From the brand name 'Magic Ink'. 麥克筆 is also used.

example.zh: 這首歌是寫給他的愛人的。
example.en: This song was written for his lover.

note: False friend: mainland 爱人 is the ordinary word for one's spouse. In Taiwan introduce a spouse as 先生 / 太太 or 老公 / 老婆.

en: Advanced Subjects Test (former July entrance exam)

example.zh: 我是考指考上大學的。
example.en: I got into university through the July exam.

note: Short for 指定科目考試 (2002–2021), replaced by 分科測驗 in 2022. Earlier generations sat the 聯考.

example.zh: 他準備高考準備了兩年。
example.en: He spent two years preparing for the civil service exam.

note: False friend: in Taiwan 高考 is the higher civil-service exam (高等考試), not the university entrance exam.

example.zh: 遲到會被教官登記。
example.en: If you're late, the instructor will write you up.

note: Military officers posted to high schools and colleges for discipline and safety; now being phased out.

example.zh: 他是推甄上台大的。
example.en: He got into NTU through recommendation.

note: Short for 推薦甄選: admission by application and interview rather than the exam alone.

en: to retake the entrance exam (after a gap year)

example.zh: 他重考一年才上醫學系。
example.en: He retook the exam after a year and got into medicine.

note: A repeater is a 重考生, typically studying at a 重考班.

example.zh: 國三生五月要考會考。
example.en: Ninth-graders take the Comprehensive Assessment in May.

note: Short for 國中教育會考, used for senior-high admission.

example.zh: 人資說下週會通知結果。
example.en: HR says they'll let us know the result next week.

note: Short for 人力資源; many people just say HR.

en: to freelance; to take on jobs

example.zh: 她辭職以後在家接案。
example.en: She's been freelancing from home since she quit.

note: A freelancer is a 接案者 or SOHO族.

example.zh: 今年的考績會影響年終。
example.en: This year's performance rating will affect the bonus.

note: 績 is read jī in Taiwan.

example.zh: 謝謝各位同仁的努力。
example.en: Thank you all for your hard work, colleagues.

note: Formal, used in announcements and speeches; the everyday word is 同事.

example.zh: 葉門在阿拉伯半島的南邊。
example.en: Yemen is in the south of the Arabian Peninsula.

example.zh: 他們去肯亞看動物大遷徙。
example.en: They went to Kenya to see the great migration.

note: 亞 is officially yà in Taiwan, though many people say yǎ.

example.zh: 奈及利亞是非洲人口最多的國家。
example.en: Nigeria is the most populous country in Africa.

note: More African names: 衣索比亞 (埃塞俄比亚), 象牙海岸 (科特迪瓦), 坦尚尼亞 (坦桑尼亚).

example.zh: 克羅埃西亞的海岸很美。
example.en: Croatia's coast is beautiful.

example.zh: 這包咖啡豆是瓜地馬拉產的。
example.en: These coffee beans are from Guatemala.

note: One of Taiwan's diplomatic allies (邦交國), so it's often in the news.

example.zh: 喬治亞是國家，也是美國的州。
example.en: Georgia is a country and also a US state.

note: The mainland distinguishes 格鲁吉亚 (the country) from 佐治亚 (the state).

example.zh: 佛羅倫斯的牛排很有名。
example.en: Florence is famous for its steak.

note: The poetic older name 翡冷翠 is also known.

example.zh: 這部片在坎城影展得獎。
example.en: This film won an award at the Cannes Film Festival.

note: 影展 = film festival (mainland 电影节).

example.zh: 很多台灣人去帛琉潛水。
example.en: Lots of Taiwanese go diving in Palau.

example.zh: 汶萊是一個很有錢的小國。
example.en: Brunei is a very rich little country.

example.zh: 柯林頓是九〇年代的美國總統。
example.en: Clinton was US president in the 1990s.

note: Taiwan likes surname-like first characters (柯, 歐, 賈, 雷). Hillary is 希拉蕊 (mainland 希拉里).

example.zh: 小布希是老布希的兒子。
example.en: Bush junior is the son of Bush senior.

example.zh: 雷根當總統以前是演員。
example.en: Reagan was an actor before he became president.

example.zh: 甘迺迪總統在一九六三年遇刺。
example.en: President Kennedy was assassinated in 1963.

note: New York's JFK is 甘迺迪機場.

example.zh: 馬克宏是法國總統。
example.en: Macron is the president of France.

note: Also 梅克爾 (Merkel, mainland 默克尔).

example.zh: 柴契爾夫人被稱為鐵娘子。
example.en: Mrs Thatcher was known as the Iron Lady.

example.zh: 邱吉爾是二戰時的英國首相。
example.en: Churchill was Britain's wartime prime minister.

example.zh: 祖克柏是臉書的創辦人。
example.en: Zuckerberg is the founder of Facebook.

example.zh: 我在聽莫札特的鋼琴曲。
example.en: I'm listening to a Mozart piano piece.

note: Also 蕭邦 (Chopin, mainland 肖邦).

example.zh: 伊莉莎白女王在位七十年。
example.en: Queen Elizabeth reigned for seventy years.

note: Taiwan favours 莉, 蕊, 絲 in women's names where the mainland uses 丽, 里, 斯.

example.zh: 柯比是我最喜歡的籃球員。
example.en: Kobe is my favourite basketball player.

note: NBA names differ too: 柯瑞 (Curry, mainland 库里), 雷霸龍 (LeBron, mainland 勒布朗).

example.zh: 這幅畫是畢卡索的作品。
example.en: This painting is a Picasso.

example.zh: 睡不著可以去看身心科。
example.en: If you can't sleep, you can see a psychiatrist.

note: A gentler name that clinics use for 精神科.

example.zh: 學校有免費的心理諮商。
example.en: The school has free counselling.

note: 諮商 = counselling; a counsellor is a 諮商師.

mainland: 痴呆症 / 阿尔茨海默病

example.zh: 阿公去年被診斷出失智症。
example.en: Grandpa was diagnosed with dementia last year.

note: 老人癡呆 is now avoided as disrespectful.

example.zh: 阿嬤住院，我們請了看護。
example.en: Grandma's in hospital, so we hired a caregiver.

note: 看 is read kān here. Live-in migrant caregivers are 外籍看護.

example.zh: 這是身心障礙專用車位。
example.en: This parking space is reserved for people with disabilities.

note: The standard respectful term (short: 身障). 殘疾 and 殘廢 are considered offensive in Taiwan.

example.zh: 這部片入圍坎城影展。
example.en: This film was selected for the Cannes Film Festival.

note: 金馬影展 is Taipei's big annual one.

example.zh: 記者扛著攝影機跑過來。
example.en: A reporter ran over shouldering a video camera.

note: A webcam is a 視訊鏡頭 (mainland 摄像头).

example.zh: 《神隱少女》是宮崎駿的動畫。
example.en: Spirited Away is a Miyazaki animation.

note: Other Ghibli titles differ too: 《霍爾的移動城堡》 (mainland 《哈尔的移动城堡》).

example.zh: 《玩命關頭》已經拍到第十集了。
example.en: Fast & Furious is already up to its tenth film.

note: Taiwan loves stock title formulas: 神鬼…, 玩命…, 終極…

example.zh: 這條街上都是精品店。
example.en: This street is all luxury boutiques.

note: On the mainland 精品 just means high-quality goods.

example.zh: 這間套房有獨立衛浴。
example.en: This studio has a private bathroom.

note: Listing shorthand: 獨立衛浴 vs 共用衛浴.

example.zh: 老公寓的窗戶都有鐵窗。
example.en: Old apartments all have grilles on the windows.

example.zh: 店已經關了，鐵捲門都拉下來了。
example.en: The shop's closed; the shutter is already down.

example.zh: 他們買的是預售屋。
example.en: They bought an off-plan home.

note: Finished new builds are 新成屋 (mainland 现房).

example.zh: 新房子太貴，我們只看中古屋。
example.en: New homes are too expensive; we're only looking at resale ones.

note: 中古 (from Japanese) = second-hand: 中古車, 中古機車.

example.zh: 這件事要管委會開會決定。
example.en: The management committee has to meet to decide this.

note: Short for 管理委員會.

example.zh: 聽說他常跟客戶去酒店。
example.en: I hear he often goes to hostess clubs with clients.

note: False friend: mainland 酒店 is simply a hotel. In Taiwan 上酒店 means visiting a hostess bar; say 飯店 for a hotel.

example.zh: 換駕照要去監理站。
example.en: You go to the motor vehicles office to renew your license.

note: Also 監理所.

example.zh: 這家KTV沒通過公安檢查。
example.en: This KTV failed its public-safety inspection.

note: False friend: mainland 公安 = the police. In Taiwan it's short for 公共安全; the police are 警察.

en: to hide or transfer assets (to dodge debts)

example.zh: 他怕被求償，早就脫產了。
example.en: Afraid of being sued for damages, he moved his assets long ago.

note: False friend: mainland 脱产 means leaving your job temporarily, e.g. for full-time study (脱产学习).

example.zh: 他是球隊的先發捕手。
example.en: He's the team's starting catcher.

note: 投手 (pitcher) is the same on both sides; a batter is a 打者 (mainland 击球员).

example.zh: 他這場比賽有五次阻攻。
example.en: He had five blocks this game.

note: Colloquially 蓋火鍋 ('serving a hot pot'). A steal is 抄截 (mainland 抢断).

example.zh: 他踢進了一顆十二碼球。
example.en: He scored a penalty.

note: A shoot-out is PK大戰; a free kick is 自由球 (mainland 任意球).

example.zh: 美式足球在美國非常紅。
example.en: American football is hugely popular in the US.

note: 橄欖球 in Taiwan is rugby.

example.zh: 小朋友在公園溜直排輪。
example.en: Kids are rollerblading in the park.

note: The verb is 溜: 溜直排輪, 溜冰, 溜滑梯.

example.zh: 中華隊打進了準決賽。
example.en: Team Taiwan made it to the semifinals.

note: Also 四強賽. The final is 決賽 or 冠軍賽.

example.zh: 今天的先發投手是誰？
example.en: Who's the starting pitcher today?

example.zh: 老闆，茶葉我要買四兩。
example.en: Boss, I'd like four taels of tea.

note: A 台兩 is 37.5 g (1/16 台斤), used for tea, herbs and gold; the mainland 两 is 50 g.

example.zh: 這根螺絲的直徑是五公釐。
example.en: This screw is five millimetres in diameter.

note: 毫米 is used too, e.g. for rainfall in weather reports.

example.zh: 質量和重量是不一樣的。
example.en: Mass and weight are not the same thing.

note: False friend: in Taiwan 質量 is physical mass only; 'quality' is 品質. 質 is read zhí.

example.zh: 政府的總預算超過三兆元。
example.en: The government's total budget exceeds three trillion dollars.

note: In Taiwan 兆 = 10¹². The mainland says 万亿 and uses 兆 for 'mega' (兆字节 = MB).

example.zh: 央行決定升息半碼。
example.en: The central bank decided to raise rates by 12.5 basis points.

note: In financial news 一碼 = 0.25%, 半碼 = 0.125%. Also the unit 'yard', and 十二碼 = penalty kick.

example.zh: 他家在鄉下有三甲地。
example.en: His family has three jia of land in the countryside.

note: A Dutch-era unit still used for farmland: 1 甲 = 2,934 坪.
